title: Omaha mother wins $11.3M after insurer refuses late husband's $350K life insurance claim
summary_full: In a landmark decision, a Nebraska jury has awarded Vaneza Ramos $11.3 million in damages after a lengthy legal struggle spanning six years. This case emerged when Farmers New World Life Insurance denied her claim following the tragic loss of her husband, Jose Gaitan, to COVID-19. With ten children to support, Ramos depended on the life insurance policy that the jury ruled Farmers Insurance improperly refused, illustrating their bad faith.
